name: Universal Donor buffs allies' healing received when Vampyr's Kiss is cast (#3642)
contract: Universal Donor 806428 reads 'Casting Infuse or Vampyr's Kiss now increases the healing received by all allies by $704238s1% for $704238d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Universal Donor 704238, an SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_RECEIVED with BasePoints 5 (+6%), TargetA 56 (the caster's raid) and radius index 12. Spell.dbc gives 806428 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no ally ever received 704238. Vampyr's Kiss is cast as rank 504281 (top of the spell_ranks chain 504275-504281, SpellFamilyFlags (32768, 0, 0)). The second player is put in the caster's group so the raid-area effect can reach them.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Universal Donor passive is active
No Universal Donor buff on the ally before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: the ally gains Universal Donor 704238
Universal Donor grants the DBC value of +6% healing received
